messages:
maria: kicking off post-deploy quickprobe grace window for release v2026.03.21 — canary -> 30m roll if green. watching synth probes and p95s :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy finished to eu-west-1 and apac3. Postdeploy smoke checks running (quickprobe, kv-warmup, tokenizer). Results streaming to #eng-releases.

kevin: seeing p95 jump on eu-west-1 embed route ~5m after deploy, from 220ms -> 480ms. small sample but correlated with synth failure counts.

maria: can you paste the quickprobe snippet? which checks failed?

kevin: quickprobe summary: 50 checks total, 12 failed, mostly 503s on /v1/embeddings. apac3 failures concentrated on tokenization stage. eu-west failures mainly p95 > threshold.

kevin: logs (head) ->
```
2026-03-21T12:05:11Z embed-worker[eid=ab12]: tokenizer timeout 1200ms -> upstream 503
2026-03-21T12:05:12Z gateway[eid=gw09]: responded 503 to synth-check /v1/embeddings  
```

maria: hmm. not widespread but not trivial. any error traces/ooms?

david_sre: no OOMs on host metrics. CPU/GPU fine. I see a short spike in host GC on some older hosts in apac3. Memory stayed steady. Suggest hold full rollout and increase synth sample size for next 10m.

oliver: +1 to hold. also recommend pinning traffic for canary to 25% (do not proceed to 100%) while we triage. If we see continued 5xx > 8% in 5m window, rollback to v2026.03.17.

maria: agreed. pinning now. deploy-bot, set rollout to 25% and extend grace window +10m.

deploy-bot: Rollout adjusted -> canary traffic now 25%. Grace window extended by 10m (new window ends in 20m). Will continue to stream quickprobe results.

ana_prodeng: fyi, release notes include small tokenizer tweak; suspect regression in tokenization fallback path. tagging model team.

kevin: increasing synthetic sampling now. new probe config: concurrent=10, sample_interval=5s for next 10m.

maria: if synth failures persist after 10m, we do rollback. If failures drop and p95 stabilizes, plan to resume rollout in a controlled 10% increments every 5m.

david_sre: running targeted smokejob against the problematic hosts: `for h in $(list-hosts apac3 tokenizers); do curl -sS http://$h:8080/health || echo $h; done` -> one host returned 503 on /health, others ok. I'll cordon that host from LB and restart process.

oliver: good call. once host restarted, re-run quickprobe and report.

deploy-bot: Quickprobe update (10m): eu-west-1 p95 now 310ms (from 480), apac3 5xx rate down to 3/50 checks.

kevin: reduced but still trending. restarted tokenizer on host apac3-token-07 resolved immediate 503s. watching for recurrence.

maria: team consensus -> stay pinned, monitor next 10m. no rollback yet. I'll update release notes and post a short note to #product. :thumbsup:

ana_prodeng: cc @model-team — please prioritize a postmortem on tokenizer fallback.

kevin: will post a short snippet of the failing payloads to the model-team thread (sanitized).

maria: thanks all. if anything spikes, tag me and we'll cut rollback. otherwise we'll continue staged rollout after grace.

oliver: noted. adding a temporary alert rule lowering the p95 threshold for these routes so oncall gets earlier notice.

deploy-bot: Final quickprobe update (20m): checks passing 94/100, p95 eu-west-1 ~280ms. No further 503s observed. Rollout remains pinned at 25% until staged resume.

maria: closing thread for now — followup doc: release-v2026.03.21-postdeploy-smoke.md (I'll attach PR).
